name: guard_item8_grant_free_push_20261025
comment: AGENTS.md 21.0.0 §28.15 item 8 (ratified 2026-10-25, PR #2128), redesigned after two DO-NOT-MERGE reviews of #2148.
(a) The only grant-free push is `bin/agent-push <branch>`: env refused then cleared, the trusted guard tree's
guard_push_free.py pushes <sha>:refs/heads/<branch> to the pinned canonical URL (fast-forward, dry run first, tracked
pre-push identical to main's, no hijacking config, no broker paths, within budget) under a resolved operator approval
(operator-authored PR comment or decision-ledger row) on the pusher's own claim or a coordinator assignment; hash-
chained guard-log lines. Raw git push keeps the grant path. (b) toolchain runs are never deps; installs are.
Every reviewer exploit (X1-X11, H1-H3, M1-M3, L1-L2) is a regression test here.
